ranked.headline: Truth-set benchmarks and T2T references refine variant calling accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs curated truth sets and complete reference genomes with new callers, enabling more rigorous evaluation of variant detection.

ranked.headline: Deep learning tools for segmenting and classifying biomedical images across modalities
ranked.summary: Generalization across cohorts is a central concern, as MICCAI 2024 results show top perivascular segmentation methods degrade on an unseen cohort.

ranked.headline: Histology as an anchor for integrating spatial omics and molecular modalities
ranked.summary: Pretrained H&E foundation models are now used as anchors for aligning spatial omics, extending integration beyond purely molecular frameworks.

ranked.headline: Optimal control and combination therapy models target bacterial and epidemic persistence
ranked.summary: Coupling within-host dynamics, treatment schedules and transmission to population outcomes is a current modeling priority in infection biology.

ranked.headline: Simulations attribute nucleic acid and nucleosome binding to defined molecular features
ranked.summary: Simulations now link binding and partitioning outcomes to specific residues and surface charge across nucleic acid and chromatin systems.

ranked.headline: Reference-standard benchmarks expose limits in multi-omics and single-cell methods
ranked.summary: Multi-omics and single-cell methods are now judged against gold-standard biomarkers, unbiased benchmarks, and batch-effect and sampling-bias tests.

ranked.headline: Software packages standardize mass spectrometry and omics data processing workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints release packages that unify search-engine outputs and vendor spreadsheets across glycoproteomics, metabolomics, and crosslinking MS.

ranked.headline: Sequencing tools for RNA modification, integration and somatic variant detection
ranked.summary: Single-molecule and long-read sequencing methods now resolve RNA modifications, integration sites and somatic variants at template-level resolution.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict drug-target affinity and disease-target associations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark hybrid deep architectures on Davis and KIBA and extend prediction to multitarget and disease-level associations.

ranked.headline: Graph learning predicts perturbation and interaction effects across biological networks
ranked.summary: Recent work applies graph attention and self-supervised learning to predict perturbation effects from transcriptomic, protein, and variant data.

ranked.headline: Individualized brain models infer stable connectivity from fMRI co-activity patterns
ranked.summary: Subject-specific whole-brain simulation from fMRI is being formalized through stable co-activity inference and individualized parcellation comparison.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks extend to binding affinity, interface, and ADME prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report geometry-aware graph models for protein-ligand affinity, binding interfaces, and ADME endpoints.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies for heterozygous cattle, grass and nematode genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and low-coverage sequencing now support complete haplotype and mitogenome recovery across diverse eukaryotic genomes.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes link microbial secretion, metal uptake and extremophile lifestyles
ranked.summary: Expanding genome and metagenome catalogs now permit trait-level comparisons across bacterial and archaeal lineages.

ranked.headline: Defense and anti-defense turnover co-evolve across Enterobacteriaceae genomes
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models now quantify defense turnover, accessory-genome selection, and phage microdiversity within explicit evolutionary frameworks.

ranked.headline: Spatial indexing and standardized scoring for whole macromolecular assembly comparison
ranked.summary: Comparison tools are shifting from individual chains to whole assembly geometry, indexing, and scoring across complex structures.

ranked.headline: Reusable pipelines and models for quality control, imputation, and regulatory genomics
ranked.summary: Standardized sequencing and omics tools now ship as open, reusable components spanning QC, variant calling, ancestry, and regulatory modeling.

ranked.headline: Adapted protein and RNA models target stability, fitness, and conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a December 2025 publication test pretrained protein language and structure models against stability, fitness, and RNA probing data.

ranked.headline: Machine learning steers antibody design toward affinity and low immunogenicity
ranked.summary: Generative and feature-engineered models now jointly target antibody affinity and immunogenicity, from zero-shot design to neoepitope prediction.

ranked.headline: Analysis Pipelines for Impedance and Metabolomic Data With Interpretable ML
ranked.summary: Impedance and metabolomic measurements are being paired with open tools and interpretable models to support clinical and mechanistic inference.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware encoders reshape learned representations of DNA, proteins and molecules
ranked.summary: Pretrained encoders for DNA, proteins and molecules are being adapted through domain-specific tokenization, substructure annotation and multiview inputs.

ranked.headline: ML models predict biosynthetic gene function and enzyme kinetics for strain engineering
ranked.summary: Attention models, LLM literature mining, and active learning are now applied to natural product, enzyme, and biosensor design.

ranked.headline: Explicit mechanistic models of promoter, metabolic, and stress-response dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints parameterize explicit mechanistic models from dwell-time, flux, proteomic, and calibration data.

ranked.headline: Structure-derived descriptors probe AlphaFold model quality and domain environments
ranked.summary: Residue-level descriptors now move AlphaFold quality assessment beyond pLDDT confidence alone, applied across whole proteomes.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases resolve neuronal subtype dynamics and isoform diversity
ranked.summary: Bulk RNA-seq and long-read proteogenomics now carry single-cell and isoform-resolved neuronal states into disease-risk and birth-order questions.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate structure prediction, docking, and biologics or drug design
ranked.summary: Agentic frameworks now chain structure prediction, docking, and ADMET tools into automated design workflows, mostly as proof-of-concept demonstrations.

ranked.headline: Explicit computational models as inferential cores in cancer evolution and therapy
ranked.summary: Recent work applies digraph, multiobjective optimization, and signature-attribution models to AML treatment, metastatic spread, and mutational processes.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level and pangenome assemblies link genome structure to fatty acid traits
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level Physaria and graph pangenome peanut assemblies now resolve centromeres, WGD analyses and the FAD2 genes behind oil fatty acid profiles.

ranked.headline: Polarizable and learned-surface methods extend computational ligand-site prediction
ranked.summary: Nucleic acid and peptide targets are pushing structure-based binding and design methods beyond single static geometries.

ranked.headline: Spatial methylomes, isoform atlases and imaging cytometry resolve tissue cell states
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell readouts are extending from transcriptomes to methylation, polyadenylation isoforms and benchmarked cell typing in tissue.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and combined tools for ML prediction in protein function and gene detection
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints emphasize benchmarking and combining existing predictors for protein function, effector, and exon detection.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for neuron modeling, brain atlas mapping, and behavior analysis
ranked.summary: Late-2025 releases pair interactive biophysical neuron modeling with atlas mapping and video-based behavioral measurement tools.

ranked.headline: GPU and k-d tree methods speed up molecular and sequence analysis workloads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication report algorithmic redesigns that cut runtime for molecular dynamics, sequence alignment, and surface computation.

ranked.headline: Computational assignment of T-cell antigen recognition and MHC-presented peptides
ranked.summary: Single-cell pMHC barcode denoising and immunopeptidomics-based tumor antigen prioritization now enable finer antigen assignment from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Computational methods sharpen spatial positioning and clone tracing in imaging assays
ranked.summary: Imaging-based spatial and chromatin tracing now depend on computational correction and barcoding to resolve single-cell positions.

ranked.headline: R tools pair curated omics and experimental-design data with analysis layers
ranked.summary: Reusable software now couples Hi-C segmentation, plate design and metagenomic exploration with standardized metadata.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell trajectories and tissue heterogeneity from single-cell transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Temporal graph, ODE, and spatial segmentation models now pair with single-cell and spatial transcriptomics to resolve injury and plaque cell states.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models of cell translocation, epithelial force inference, and cytokinetic flow
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie cell-scale mechanical models to experimental or time-resolved data, linking biophysical simulation with measured deformation and flow.

ranked.headline: Integrating chromatin contacts, RNA association and binding order in regulatory control
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair enhancer-promoter contact maps with RNA-DNA contacts and single-cell binding-order inference to dissect transcriptional regulation.

ranked.headline: Hi-C-based 3D models resolve ecDNA, nuclear organization and replication timing
ranked.summary: Hi-C-derived 3D models now reach extrachromosomal DNA, single-cell human nuclear architecture and replication timing in yeast.
